design: A 64 KiB dynamic constant buffer uses 256-byte slots. A frame starts with DISCARD; subsequent changed constants append with NO_OVERWRITE until wrap, which discards again. Range bindings are restored after custom passes. Both required D3D11 options are queried; unsupported drivers retain the existing discard path.

validation.new_pixel_regression: 300 isolated opacity groups across three frames on WARP and hardware, exceeding 256 changed constant ranges; matches the reference.
validation.path_confirmation: Targeted regression reports 65,808 live constant-buffer bytes on WARP and Radeon, confirming the 64 KiB stream plus custom/compute buffers; integrated adapter conformance passes but its active path was not separately logged.
validation.legacy_path: Forced legacy allocation and uploads match range uploads byte-for-byte over five frames, including repeated constants, opacity layers and context ClearState between frames.

limits: The existing path is selected when either required capability is absent. WARP and Radeon range-path activation and forced legacy-path rendering are validated; integrated conformance passes without a separate active-path log.
Correctness checks do not establish a performance gain; the measured medians do not justify integrating this change.
outcome: REJECTED after the focused Editor comparison in result.json; correctness passes but no memory gain is established.
